deploy-bot: Starting rollout for service=rl-inference-api release=v3.4.1 Canary=5% change-window=2026-03-17T15:00Z-16:00Z
sahil.k: seeing early 95p latency spike on canary pods, +120ms vs baseline. Any immediate abort criteria?
maria.g: open runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-for-inference.md (see section 2.1 thresholds). If 95p > +100ms for 3 consecutive mins, escalate.
joel: confirm: metric is 95p latency, not P50?
sahil.k: yep 95p. CPU on those nodes also jumped, a couple of OOM-like GC pauses in logs.
sahil.k: i'm pausing the rollout and will pin traffic back to the previous version until we triage.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused by sahil.k at 2026-03-17T15:07:05Z
maria.g: Runbook step: grab the canary pod logs and KV cache warmup traces, attach to INC-7621. Also run the ``kv-cache-prime`` diagnostic. Link to runbook excerpt: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-for-inference.md#kv-cache
sahil.k: running helper: 
```
# rollback helper
/deploy pause rl-inference-api --by sahil.k
/deploy pin rl-inference-api v3.4.0 --reason "95p latency regression on canary"
```
oncall-bot: Pin request queued (id=px-9983). ETA: ~90s
deploy-bot: Pin applied: rl-inference-api pinned to v3.4.0 by sahil.k at 2026-03-17T15:08:45Z
joel: good call. Please capture the canary metric graphs and a short blurb for release notes (so we can annotate the outage window).
maria.g: kicked off a focused eval job against the critical prompt set; will post perf diffs in ~10m. Also recommending we run ``kv-cache-prime`` before next canary.
sahil.k: I've created INC-7621 and added the initial triage notes. Marking this thread for follow-up in eng-releases sync. :thumbsup:
notes: short canary regression -> pause -> pin to prior version; runbook referenced and incident INC-7621 created
